verdict.rationale: Runpod is a GPU compute/infrastructure platform with CLI, API, templates, and MCP integrations, but there is no evidence of any versioning, review, or rollback mechanism for automations/workflows (e.g., no config-as-code history, no diff/approval workflow, no revert feature for deployed jobs or endpoints). This axis applies since automation-depth tools could plausibly ship such governance features, but none is documented.
